definitions.explanation: The state of being a member of or affiliated with an organization, group, or department. As a suru verb, means to belong to or be affiliated with.

examples.japanese: ⟦サッカー→サッカー：04726_sakkaa⟧⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{所属|しょぞく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I belong to the soccer club.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}{部|ぶ}→営業部：19381_eigyoubu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{所属|しょぞく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He belongs to the sales department.

examples.japanese: {所属|しょぞく}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{部署|ぶしょ}→部署：08187_busho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write the name and department of your affiliation.

notes:
{所属|しょぞく} means belonging to or being affiliated with a group or organization. It is commonly used for workplace departments, sports teams, and academic institutions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{所属|しょぞく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to belong to ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {所属|しょぞく}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: one's affiliation, organization one belongs to
- {所属|しょぞく}⟦{部署|ぶしょ}→部署：08187_busho⟧: department one belongs to
- {所属|しょぞく}⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧: affiliated player
- {所属|しょぞく}⟦{事務所|じむしょ}→事務所：01032_jimusho⟧: talent agency one belongs to
